svg.title: Cloudra architecture: reaction-specific evidence
svg.desc: Editable vector architecture. Short dashed links connect corresponding reactant/product atoms on two offset schematic drawing planes, not physical three-dimensional molecular coordinates. A separate bracketed pair of butadiene conformations shows a sampled set within one molecular graph, without a directional conversion or equilibrium arrow. No correspondence links connect those two conformers. This four-carbon illustration is not claimed to execute the large-search-space MCS-seeding branch. Watched pairs combine bond edits and endpoint distance variations; highlighted pair 3-4 is one member of W, not necessarily the whole set. The eta formula defines a mode-alignment diagnostic without an acceptance threshold. Geometry preparation retains atom identities while sampling conformations. Computational artifacts support reaction-centre mode diagnostics and a provenance-linked, same-transition-state bidirectional IRC chain. Endpoint optimization and frequency analysis precede comparison against the R and P identity graphs. Evidence is bound to the corresponding elementary step between species occurrences. The qualitative mode-pair arrows and partial-bond sketch are diagnostic illustrations, not computed eigenvectors or an optimized transition-state geometry. Molecular drawings in the graph encode identity, not direct IRC endpoint conformations.

g.aria-label: eta equals maximum relative displacement over watched pairs divided by maximum over all atom pairs
